integrity: The characteristic polynomial, discriminant factorization, Sturm count, stationary-point reduction, and numerical root values are independently replayable from the included standard-library checker. Finite numerical checks are used only to replay exact algebraic identities and decimal isolation, not as the proof of the continuum statement.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for three identical scalar strongly convex quadratic blocks with the single sum constraint and the standard multiplier step; no general multiblock tuning theorem is claimed. Full later pages of DOI 10.4208/eajam.240817.010318 were not available through the lawful access routes checked, leaving a documented originality risk.
title: Critical-damping penalty for symmetric three-block ADMM
